title: On Shopify, a last weight added on the Weight value page answers onboarding with answered(null), which never lands; one typed in the grid answers weightKg and lands
evidence: widget-src/src/components/InputPanel.tsx:651 passes ValuePage onWeightAnswered={answered && (() => answered(null))}, while the grid path at :540 answers answered(past ? null : 'weightKg'). So a last weight added through ValuePage AddValue (widget-src/src/components/ValuePage.tsx:304) never lands the onboarding, while the same weight typed in the grid does. The prop comment (ValuePage.tsx:59, "as the weight box gives it") claims parity. Also: AddValue marks the answer before every weight Add (:304, before onSave), including "No change" and a refused save. (H80)
